device.description: 8-bit 80 MSPS pipelined ADC with internal/external reference and CMOS parallel outputs (3 V / 5 V output driver supply)
device.note: ads831.pdf (SBAS087A) p.3 specifications (convert on the rising clock edge, VIH 3.5 V, straight offset binary, +VS 4.75-5.25 V, VDRV 3 V or 5 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12 ns max, 4-clock latency), p.7 theory of operation (data valid on the rising clock edge), p.11 VDRV, digital outputs, Table I coding

pages: p.3 (specifications), p.4 (pinout, pin descriptions, timing diagram: t2 12 ns), p.7 (theory of operation), p.11 (VDRV, digital outputs, Table I)
notModeled: analog input and reference; the result is always the 0 V differential (bipolar zero) code 80h, straight offset binary
RSEL (input range 1 V / 2 V) and INT/EXT (internal/external reference) straps only change the analog range; they are stored nowhere
pipeline latency of 4 clock cycles (the code is constant)
clock period / duty-cycle limits (12.5 ns to 100 us) and aperture delay

two supplies: +VS 4.75-5.25 V (analog core and CLK input, VIH 3.5 V) and VDRV (output drivers, 3 V or 5 V logic); vcc is the union 3.0-5.25 V and +VS is listed under analog so VDRV is the digital supply
no output-enable or power-down pin: the outputs always drive
pin 16 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar in the datasheet); both inputs are named IN
variants: ADS830 (60 MSPS, CLK VIH 2.4 V) and ADS831 (80 MSPS, CLK VIH 3.5 V) are pin-for-pin compatible, each with its own datasheet
